Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
- Add named settings profiles with automatic saving, create/switch/rename/delete controls, and profile import/export.
- Make Shift stop standalone venture cycles as well as full sequences, including venture and dialogue windows.
- Wait for the withdrawal context menu before selecting Return Items to Inventory for an approved NPC sale.
- Wait for Extract/Retrieve Materia menus during desynthesis instead of requiring a second start attempt.
